claims.text: Canonical Ap–density links (contemporaneous Ap↔ρ₃₂₅, Ap↔ρ₈₂₅; lagged Ap→ρ₃₂₅ at 53 d) are retained under family-separated structural controls (IAAFT, circular shift).
Spurious control→physical links are few (7 IAAFT, 4 shift) and weak (median |r| ≈ 0.04) relative to the canonical links.
